'''Heidia''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Appearance ==
She is slender.

== Activities ==
She guards [[Rand al'Thor]] when he [[Travel]]s back into [[Arad Doman]].

== Trivia ==
* Heidia is named for Heidi Soderquist, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
